versionPolicy.schemaVersion: Version of this JSON document shape. Bump when fields in the contract document itself are added, removed, or structurally changed.
versionPolicy.contractVersion: Version of the generated HTML runtime semantics. Bump when the required HTML globals, window.__gameState shape, phaseEvidence envelope, or hard gates change.

generationInput.description: Input bundle for the storyboard2html generator. The specs come from ctx.blueprint.specs after spec-extract; storyboardFrames come from ctx.blueprint.storyboard.frames or ctx.blueprint.storyboardFrames.

requiredGlobals.name: window.__BP_SOURCE_IR__
requiredGlobals.contract: Canonical SourceSceneIR semantic payload. New storyboard2html output must derive PHASES, ENTITY_STYLE, ENTITY_POSITIONS, SCENE_CONFIG, HUD, camera, resources, steps, and gates from this object instead of duplicating independent semantic facts.

requiredGlobals.name: window.__BP_SOURCE_IR_HASH__
requiredGlobals.contract: sha256 of the normalized SourceSceneIR semantic payload. The source-scene-ir preflight recomputes this hash when present.

requiredGlobals.name: window.__BP_SOURCE_IR_PREVIEW_RENDERER_VERSION__
requiredGlobals.contract: Marker that the source HTML preview surface is rendered by the SourceSceneIR preview renderer rather than by an independent JS semantic/runtime model.

requiredGlobals.name: window.__BP_SOURCE_IR_RENDERER_OWNS_VISUALS__
requiredGlobals.contract: Must be true when source HTML visual/UI/model state is derived from SourceSceneIR.

requiredGlobals.name: window.__BP_SOURCE_IR_RENDERER_OWNS_PHASE_DRIVER__
requiredGlobals.contract: Must be true when source HTML phase switching hooks are driven from SourceSceneIR phases.

requiredGlobals.name: window.__driveToSourcePhase
requiredGlobals.contract: Source-specific deterministic phase driver. Must share behavior with window.__driveToPhase and settle before visual-diff screenshots.

requiredGlobals.name: setTip
requiredGlobals.contract: Must visibly update guide text and store the latest text so window.__gameState().ui_state.guideText can expose it.

phaseFunctionNaming.note: Named phase functions are not a hard runtime requirement, but they are the preferred fallback when PHASES cannot be parsed.

aliases.policy: snake_case keys are hard-required. camelCase aliases are optional mirrors only; generated HTML must not write camelCase without the corresponding snake_case key.

phaseRealTimer.requirement: Must be based on real elapsed wall-clock time for the current phase, not animation-frame count.

regressionHook.legacyDemo2specBridge: node adapters/demo2spec/index.js <generated.html> <outdir> --blueprint-smoke --verify --steps <n> (legacy bridge only; SourceIR-only, no JS inference fallback)
hardGates: source-visual-ir.json exists and hash-binds to source-ir.json
phaseCoverage completed count equals expected phase count
